newsitem.title: USA: Minnesota soy 19 percent seeded, corn 78 percent.
newsitem.headline: Minnesota soy 19 percent seeded, corn 78 percent.

text.p: Soybean seedings stood at 19 percent complete and corn seedings were 78 percent complete as of Sunday, according to the Minnesota Agricultural Statistics Service.
The soybean seeding pace was ahead of the 13 percent average and the four percent pace of a year ago.
Corn seedings were ahead of the 49 percent average and up from 41 percent a year ago.
Spring wheat seedings stood at 24 percent complete, behind the 51 percent average pace but well ahead of the 14 percent pace of a year ago.
Barley seedings stood at 22 percent complete, behind the 46 percent average but ahead of the 10 percent of a year ago.
Oat seedings were at 81 percent complete, ahead of the 73 percent average and the 71 percent of a year ago.
Topsoil moisture was 20 percent surplus, 71 percent adequate, six percent short and three percent very short.
Pasture conditions were four percent very poor, 25 percent poor, 44 percent fair, 26 percent good and one percent excellent.
